dsh-plugin-notify-sound 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。按工作区定制的任务完成铃声，以及审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败等需要人介入事件的注意提示音，支持内置合成音、语音播报与自定义音频。

posts.en:
dsh-plugin-notify-sound is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice (TTS), and custom audio.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-34adfe209a650c146af3.html
